author: Unknown (translated)
pages:
[The tablet is slick with something that is not water. The script crawls; a later hand has written a translation underneath.]

The coral grows as we will it. The towers rise. The dry folk build in dead stone and wonder why their cities fall.

Count the drowned. Every sailor the sea gives us is a rower. Every rower is a voyage. Every voyage is a harvest.

Patience is the only magic. We have more of it than they have of anything.
[translator's note] Burn this after reading. I mean it. I have not slept since I copied it out.
